children.children: Polestar is continuously developing the systems in the cars and the services offered to you. Software updates in your car can give you access to many new features and improvements. The car's software can be updated to the latest version over the air (OTA) or in connection with a service at an authorised Polestar workshop. You will be informed in the centre display when new software is available as an over-the-air (OTA) update. Go to the app view, then press the "Settings" icon, "System" and "Software updates" to see the current software version.
Note
Functionality after updating may vary depending on market, model year and options.
Some updates are available at workshops before they are available over the air (OTA).
Previously released updates are also included when updating to the latest version.
Once a software update is available, you will find it here along with any previous updates.
Updates In Software Version P4.2.11
This software update provides general improvements and compatibility updates. It includes the software content released in all previous updates.
Updates In Software Version P4.2.10

children: Improvements to battery pre-conditioning, including the system now acting more dynamically, allowing the conditioning to start earlier and reach a higher temperature improving overall charging performance

children.children: To start the pre-conditioning it is required to set a DC fast charger (>70 kW) as the destination in the built-in Google Maps app and ensure the estimated state of charge when arriving is kept above 7%
On long trips with multiple stops, ensure that the charging stop is prioritized and your first stop in the route guidance
Improvements to the climate system, including a bug fix when the climate system was sporadically blowing cold air
ADAS improvements

children: Improvements to Road Sign Information, including a bug fix to prevent the system from reading road signs on parallel roads

children.children: This also includes improvements to mitigate scenarios where the Road Sign Information showed speed limits in mph
Updates In Software Version P4.2.9

children: Plug &  Charge is introduced. This functionality automatically authenticates, authorizes, and starts charging at Plug & Charge supported stations without the need for manual payment, using the secure ISO 15118 standard for communication between the car and charger. Simply find charging stations that support Plug & Charge through Google Maps in the centre display or in the Polestar Charge app

children.children: Activation instructions of Plug & Charge are available in the Polestar App and in the car’s centre display in the Charging menu
Audible confirmation when locking the vehicle is introduced. After installation the function is set to ‘off’ as a default and can be turned on by users in the exterior settings for locking
Improvements on seat heating function when using APP
Improvements on the steering wheel heating
Wiper service position can now be activated without having to deactivate the automatic wipers. The vehicle is required to be in PARK to activate service position
Rear auto brake for static objects during parking manoeuvres is introduced. A button is added in the camera view to disable it, and the function will remain disabled until re-activated by user

children: Enabling Digital key functionality for Apple devices

children.children: Applies to United Arab Emirates and Kuwait only.
To activate digital key, a special code is required. This code will be sent to all primary drivers when the full functionality is released at a later date
Additional improvements

children: Lane change assist now saves the preferred setting between driving cycles

children.children: Previously, it was default off each driving cycle
Automatic resume of stop & go when using Pilot assist or Adaptive Cruise Control now cancels the assisted driving after more than 10 seconds of being at a complete standstill

children: Automatic headlight functionality now ensures the headlights turn off automatically when the vehicle transitions from active to inactive mode when the driver’s door is opened

children.children: Previously, the headlights remained turned on until the car was locked or the home safety lights cycle was completed (if the setting was activated)
The headlights will now turn on again to complete the home safety lights cycle if the setting is activated

children: Improvements to the infotainment system including translation corrections and minor UX/UI updates such as digital key for Apple watch will now be displayed with a watch symbol in the shared keys list in-car

children.children: Previously, a shared key for Apple Watch was displayed with a phone symbol

children: Improvement to the Google maps energy estimation to reflect a more realistic estimated state of charge at arrival using dynamic consumption data

children.children: Previously, the estimation was calculated based on static consumption data
Improvement to Apple CarPlay including a bug fix for when Siri was interrupted while replying to text messages
Improvements to the climate settings including a bug fix for when it wasn’t possible to adjust the air vents in the climate settings
Improvements to syncing settings between the Polestar app and the car

children: Improvements to heating of the area for forward looking cameras in the windscreen, including heating of this area to start, if needed, also when pre-conditioning the car

children.children: The heating starts when the ambient temperature is below 1°C/33°F
Improvements to the alarm internal movement sensor, including improved sensitivity
Bug fixes

children: Bug fix for when the steering wheel heating didn’t start in colder climates with the automatic steering wheel heat setting activated

children.children: The steering wheel heat starts when the ambient temperature is below 10°C/50°F
Bug fix for when the steering wheel could create sporadic vibrations in low-speed manoeuvres
Note

children: Should you experience some functions not being available during the first drive cycle after successful installation of this software version, we recommend you restart the infotainment system

children.children: Updates In Software Version P4.2.8
The content of this software update is identical to P4.2.7.
Bug fix for when TMAP was not showing the map in the driver display unless a navigation route was active
Compatibility update
Updates In Software Version P4.2.7
Bug fix for issue where old text messages were reiterated when phone is connecting to Bluetooth
Centre display stability improvements covering translation corrections
General stability improvements
Video streaming services improvements including mitigation of video signals causing sound to play without picture
Seat heating improvement to increase the overall seat heating temperature by 2 degrees when someone is seated
Seat heating improvement to increase the overall seat heating temperature by 2 degrees
Animal mode now automatically turns off headlights when activated. The headlights will return to chosen setting once animal mode is turned off

children: Set climate timers will now start 30 minutes prior set departure time

children.children: Previously the timer started 15 minutes prior set time. Should the user not enter the vehicle at set departure time, the climate will continue to run for an additional 10 minutes before turning off

children: Pre-conditioning the cabin climate via direct start in the Polestar app will now run for 30 minutes before switching off

children.children: Previously, the climate ran for 15 minutes after direct start

children: Dashcam settings are now saved to driver profiles

children.children: Your preferred settings will now be saved to your driver profile, allowing the user to accept the privacy preference at first time of use only. All settings, including automatic emergency recording, will now remain between drive cycles
The guest profile will always restore to default settings between drive cycles as well as require an acceptance of the privacy preference at every use

children: While parked, if the driver’s door is left open and no driver is detected in the seat, any music currently playing will pause

children.children: Previously, music continued to play until the vehicle was locked
ADAS improvements
Improved steering interactions in low speed when using Pilot assist
Improved braking interactions when using Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) and Pilot assist

Long press of adjustment to set target speed value is improved to provide a slower reaction. This makes it easier to change the target speed per 1 km/h and improves the overall usage of assisted driving. A short press will remain with increase/decrease of set target speed by 5 km/h

Adjustment of set target speed value by short press is changed to 1 mph per press. Previously a short press would adjust the target speed by 5 mph. This has now been changed to be adjusted by a long press
Updates In Software Version P4.2.6
Bug fix for issue where Adaptive Cruise Control would deactivate in trailer mode.
Improvement to issue with steering wheel vibrations occurring whilst driving at low speeds.
Updates In Software Version P4.2.5
Center display stability improvements

children: Edit button now added to the Favorites app and Shortcuts widget

children.children: Previously, the widget could only be edited by holding and pressing the app or shortcut you wish to edit. An edit button has now been added to the top right corner of the widget.
Speed limit warning turned off. Function now includes a dismiss button to allow the driver to actively dismiss the notification
A/C climate calibration improvements
Digital Key pairing improvements
Parking sensors are now deactivated when Car Wash Mode is active
General stability improvements
ADAS improvements

children: Pilot Assist now uses a new AI-based method for lateral control, following the drive path within the lane instead of just the center. The steering control will now handle road curves in a more natural manner.

children.children: This does not reduce the driver's responsibility to operate the car as safely as possible.

children: Lane Keeping Aid now improved to allow setting for steering wheel vibrations only

children.children: Previously the Lane keeping aid system would only allow for an ON or OFF setting, the ON setting would allow both steering interventions and vibrations. You can now select if you want ‘only vibrations’ or ‘vibrations and steering interventions’ when selecting ON. Please note that the steering interventions will still be active for solid road lines and edges.
Pilot Assist now works up to 150 km/h. If speed exceeds 150 km/h while using Pilot Assist, lateral control will automatically resume when speed drops below 150 km/h again
Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) now works up to 180 km/h
Tuning improvements to ACC and Pilot Assist to provide a smoother acceleration and braking experience
Pilot Assist improved to avoid unnecessary brake interventions while driving.
“Driver Not Detected” warnings system improved to reduce amount of false messages
Updates In Software Version P4.2.4
Launch of dozen new apps through Google Built-in, all which can be enjoyed while the vehicle is parked. Check out the full list of apps on the Google Play Store.

children: Driver’s profile will now be selected when opening the driver’s door, even in the scenario where the passenger door has already been unlocked and opened by another key. The driver’s profile needs to have a key already connected for this to function.

children.children: Previously the vehicle would always default to whichever profile’s key opened the car first, not to the driver entering the car.
More functions have now been added to the favorite's shortcut
Optimize the control performance of remote and scheduled air conditioning
Optimize the control logic of remote steering wheel heating function
Optimize the smoothness during reversing
General stability improvements

Charging speed now shown as kW in driver display.
Automatic climate mode improved to avoid issue with air conditioning not cooling car sufficiently.
Centre display stability improvements to prevent unresponsive behaviour or screen resetting.
Apple CarPlay stability improvements to avoid echo during phone calls in car, as well as connectivity issues between car and phone device.
Scheduled charging improved resolving issue with timer not setting or charging not starting at set time.

children: Digital key improved to prevent issue with centre display settings not correctly showing successfully paired and shared digital keys

children.children: Not available in the United Arab Emirates or Kuwait.
Favourite shortcuts in centre display improved to prevent issue with loss of saved shortcuts.
Software release notes now available in centre display.
Journey Log app enabled. The Journey Log app can be downloaded from Google Play Store and helps drivers automatically track and record trips.

children: Dashcam app now available (requires micro-SD card).

children.children: The car will not allow the video stream to be active while driving, however the functions “Record video” and “Take photo” can still be utilized while driving.
Additional improvements:
Seat heating stability improvement.
Charge limit stability improvement to issue with limit unexpectedly changing to 50%.

children: Adaptive Cruise Control is now activated by pressing the steering wheel button once. For cars with pilot pack, Adaptive Cruise Control will be activated with one press after activating Pilot Assist. You can toggle between the two functions by pressing the button once.

children.children: Adaptive Cruise Control was previously activated by quickly pressing the Pilot Assist button twice in succession. This has now been removed.
Pilot Assist & Adaptive Cruise Control set to adapt to the speed limit function reinstated.

Introduction of a driver display message alerting you when the driver alert system is temporarily unavailable. This may occur if, for example, you cover parts of your face during driving, and the system cannot detect you.

Disclaimer: After over the air update installation is completed, you might get a yellow brake system warning light in the driver display. This indicates that the system needs to do a self-check. Please put the gear in P, open then close the driver door and wait for 90 seconds in the car without pressing any pedals. All the systems checks have now been completed and the yellow warning light should not be displayed.
